F-A11Y (round-3 audit) — pa11y-ci config for the public, unauthenticated surface. Run `npm run a11y` while a dev server is up at :5173. Auth-gated routes (/projects, /v3/*, /admin) need a follow-up that primes a session cookie before crawling — tracked in docs/plans/a11y-coverage-plan.md (TODO).

The rule set below is pa11y's WCAG2AA preset plus explicit thresholds for the contrast classes the round-3 audit flagged:
  - color-contrast    (text vs surface, AA-body 4.5)
  - link-name         (links must have accessible names)
  - image-alt         (images must have alt text)
  - heading-order     (no skipped h-levels)
  - aria-required-attr  (a11y tree completeness)

The `runners` array uses axe-core under pa11y because axe has the more rigorous SC 1.4.11 non-text contrast check that flags the border-default and status-executing regressions our token sweep just fixed.
